design_philosophy: Authoritative, trustworthy, and functional. Uses sharp contrasts between pristine white space, deep black text, and striking RE/MAX brand colors (Royal Blue & Vibrant Red). Minimalist geometry to allow properties to shine.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-[#0A0A0A] leading-tight

buttons.primary: bg-[#003DA5] hover:bg-[#002b75] text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-none transition-colors duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-[#DC1C2E] hover:bg-[#a31522] text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-none transition-colors duration-200
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#003DA5] text-[#003DA5] hover:bg-[#003DA5] hover:text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-none transition-colors duration-200

cards.property: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 rounded-none overflow-hidden
cards.team: bg-[#F9FAFB] border border-[#E5E7EB] hover:border-[#003DA5] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none text-center p-6

ui_components.tags: bg-[#F3F4F6] text-[#0A0A0A] text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 uppercase tracking-wide

specific_instructions_to_main_agent.language: Strictly Czech (cs). All copy, navigation, buttons, and dummy data must be in Czech.
specific_instructions_to_main_agent.branding_logo:
Implement the RE/MAX logo using typography styling to bypass image constraints: `
RE/MAXActive Broker
`
specific_instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility_and_testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='contact-submit-btn'`).
specific_instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Required icons: Home, Phone, Mail, MapPin, Search, Menu, X, ChevronRight, User, Key, Building.
specific_instructions_to_main_agent.homepage_hero: Hero overlay should not obscure the image entirely. Use a gradient mask or `bg-white/20` with dark, high-contrast text block for legibility. Include a prominent CTA 'Kontaktujte nás' (Contact Us) and 'Prodat nemovitost' (Sell a Property).
specific_instructions_to_main_agent.about_section: Use a Bento Grid layout (Mode A) to display local Tachov knowledge, team ethos, and stats.
specific_instructions_to_main_agent.admin_dashboard: Use Shadcn components for Data Tables, Inputs, and Dialogs. The dashboard should use `bg-[#F9FAFB]` to contrast with pure white `#FFFFFF` cards. Active sidebar links should use `#003DA5` background with white text.
specific_instructions_to_main_agent.property_cards: Each card must show high-res image, price prominently in `#003DA5`, beds, baths, and square meters, plus a 'Zobrazit detail' (View Detail) button.
